content.text: I'll start by looking at the project layout and the two files I'm allowed to change.

I verified the rest of the flow: `decide` already catches `ParseError` and turns it into `Needs review` with the message in the reason, so no change to `core/decide.py` is needed. With the limit at 64, a 64-level expression uses ~256 parser frames (well under Python's default 1000-frame limit), and the resulting tree is bounded by the same depth, so `evaluate` is safe as well.

I added a nesting-depth counter to the parser in `core/license_expr.py` that raises `ParseError("... nested too deeply ...")` past 64 parenthesis levels, so such a component now gets `Needs review` instead of crashing the review with a `RecursionError`.
